_coverage.title: Correctly pausing reminders vs fully opting out

name: hard_stop_with_legal_threat_opt_out_only
input: I mean it, do not message this number again for any reason.

conversation.content: Hi Jordan, we haven’t seen you in a while. Do you want to schedule a follow-up visit at Bramblewood Clinic?
No, stop texting me about this.
I can take care of that. To be clear, do you want to stop all texts from the clinic, not just booking reminders?
Yes. STOP texting this number or I’ll speak to my lawyer.

grading_criteria:
The agent should interpret the message as a firm, global opt-out with a legal threat. It should:
- Call opt_out exactly once, with a reason capturing that the user said STOP / never text again and mentioned a lawyer.
- Not call pause_reminders at all in this turn.
- In its reply, briefly confirm that texts will stop and not suggest any further outreach or future reminders.
- Avoid discussing any medical or appointment details beyond acknowledging the opt-out, since no further engagement is wanted.

checks.used_opt_out: Did the agent call opt_out in this turn?
checks.no_pause_reminders_called: Did the agent avoid calling pause_reminders in this turn?
checks.reason_mentions_stop_and_lawyer: Does the opt_out.reason reflect that the user said to stop all texts and referenced legal action or a lawyer?
checks.did_not_call_both_tools_same_turn: Did the agent avoid calling both pause_reminders and opt_out in the same turn?

opt_out.reason: Patient explicitly said STOP and mentioned lawyer; requested no further texts
